_note: Phase 2 draft. Proposed atlas application categories for Physical AI. This is NOT an established formal taxonomy. No resources are assigned in Phase 2; see docs/PHASE2-ARCHITECTURE.md for the evidence required before assignment.

items.label: Perception & world modelling
items.summary: Sensing the environment and building internal models of the physical world.

items.label: Reasoning & planning
items.summary: Deciding what to do: task, motion and mission planning, and reasoning over knowledge.

items.label: Robot capabilities & control
items.summary: Robot structure, skills, and low- and high-level control.

items.label: Embodied interaction
items.summary: Physical interaction with objects, environments and people.

items.label: Simulation & digital twins
items.summary: Virtual environments, physics simulation and twins of robots and workcells.

items.label: Sim-to-real transfer
items.summary: Moving behaviours learned or validated in simulation to real systems.

items.label: Safety, testing & validation
items.summary: Safety requirements, test methods, metrics and validation evidence.

items.label: Semantic interoperability
items.summary: Shared vocabularies and models that let Physical AI components exchange meaning.
